description: Implementation of the cell_scheduler class managing scheduling tasks for a cell in a wireless network, including slot handling, resource management, and interactions with various sub-schedulers.

classes.name: cell_scheduler
classes.description: Manages scheduling operations for a specific cell, including slot processing, resource management, and coordination with sub-schedulers.

methods.name: cell_scheduler::cell_scheduler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cell scheduler with configuration, message, and handler references.

methods.name: cell_scheduler::handle_crc_indication
methods.description: Processes CRC indications, forwarding Msg3 CRCs and other CRCs to appropriate handlers.

methods.name: cell_scheduler::run_slot
methods.description: Executes scheduling tasks for a given slot, including resource allocation and logging.

methods.name: cell_scheduler::handle_error_indication
methods.description: Handles error indications during slot processing.

methods.name: cell_scheduler::reset_resource_grid
methods.description: Resets resource allocations for a given slot.

methods.name: cell_scheduler::start
methods.description: Activates the cell scheduler if not already active.

methods.name: cell_scheduler::stop
methods.description: Deactivates the cell scheduler and stops all sub-components.
